Description: Defeat your first enemy.
Draw: A single sturdy boot planted on the lowest of three chunky stone steps rising to the upper right.
Said: One down. The realm does not notice, but you do.
Everything above this is the same thing again, harder.

Description: Sit through the whole lesson.
Draw: A thick closed book seen at a slight angle, a teacher's pointer stick laid diagonally across its cover.
Said: Bob has said his piece and gone back to wherever he waits.
Nothing he told you was untrue. Nothing he told you was all of it.

Description: Play a turn that forms No Hand.
Draw: Two open hands raised and spread in a shrug, palms out, holding nothing at all.
Said: Congrats...do you need to do the tutorial again?

Description: Weaken a 1 AP attack until it comes back round as its 3 AP card.
Draw: A small mouse standing upright and flexing one hugely muscled arm, round ears and a long curling tail.
Said: Smaller and smaller, until it was not small at all.

Description: Strengthen a 3 AP attack until it comes back round as its 1 AP card.
Draw: A heavy dumbbell snapped clean in two at its bar, the two halves tipping apart.
Said: Bigger and bigger, and then all of it, gone.

Description: Attack with four elements in one turn.
Draw: Four broad arcs nested one inside the next, like a short thick rainbow, each band separated by a dark contour line.
Said: Four colors in one breath.
The hand ladder does not pay for this. Do it anyway.

Description: Attack with all five elements in one turn.
Draw: A five-pointed star with a different element at each point — a flame, an ice shard, a lightning bolt, a rock and a curling wisp — meeting at the center.
Said: Fire, ice, lightning, earth and arcane, all in the same swing.
Every relic you own fired at once, and every one you do not sat out.

Description: Attack with a stab, a slash and a crush in one turn.
Draw: A spear, a curved scimitar and a club crossed at their middles in a heraldic trophy.
Said: Three ways of hitting, none of them wasted.
A rung the ladder used to have, and could never price.

Description: All three attack forms and a defense, in one turn.
Draw: A round shield, with the tips of a spear, a scimitar and a club fanned out behind it.
Said: Everything the deck can be, on the table at once.
Four forms. There is no fifth.

Description: Five attacks of one form or one card, in all five elements.
Draw: A triangular glass prism, one broad beam entering on the left and five broad rays fanning out on the right.
Said: One shape, every color.
The narrowest hand in the game and the widest, at the same time.

Description: Journey as far as the fifth realm.
Draw: A tall stone archway with a swirling spiral filling the opening and five notches cut into the keystone.
Said: Four realms behind you and more to come.
Whatever you came in wearing, you are not wearing it now.

Description: Play 50 stabbing cards.
Draw: A large sewing needle with a loop of thick thread through its eye, stabbed through a small square of cloth.
Said: Fifty holes, and every one of them where you meant it.

Description: Play 50 slashing cards.
Draw: A short knife beside a half-whittled stick, big curls of wood shaving falling away from it.
Said: Fifty cuts. The shavings are starting to pile up.

Description: Play 50 crushing cards.
Draw: A meat-tenderizing mallet with a square studded head and a short thick handle.
Said: Fifty blows, and nothing on the other end is the shape it was.

Description: Play 50 fire cards.
Draw: A small bundle of sticks tied with twine, a single flame rising from its middle.
Said: Fifty sparks. Something is going to catch.

Description: Play 50 ice cards.
Draw: A thick twig snapped in two, both halves sheathed in chunky ice with a few icicles hanging down.
Said: Fifty of them, and the room has not warmed since.

Description: Play 50 lightning cards.
Draw: A lightning rod standing on the peak of a small pitched roof, a jagged bolt striking its tip.
Said: Fifty strikes in the same place. So much for the saying.

Description: Play 50 earth cards.
Draw: A squat square block of stone with three bold horizontal layers, solid like a foundation stone.
Said: Fifty stones laid. It is starting to look like a foundation.

Description: Play 50 arcane cards.
Draw: An open spellbook with a small glowing sigil — a circle with a star inside it — floating above its pages.
Said: Fifty workings, and the words have stopped feeling borrowed.

Description: Play 300 slashing cards.
Draw: A curved scimitar mid-swing, three broad overlapping arcs trailing behind its edge.
Said: Three hundred of them, and the edge has not dulled.
You have a favorite. That is fine. It is also readable.

Description: Play the Bash card 200 times.
Draw: A blacksmith's anvil with a heavy club resting across it, the anvil's top pocked with dents.
Said: Two hundred Bashes. The middle rung of the crushes, over and over.
Nothing fancy has ever needed to be.

Description: Stand behind ten shields at once.
Draw: A wall of round shields overlapping one behind another, the front one whole and unmarked.
Said: Ten of them, and a turn can only throw five.
Five more than anything on the journey can reach. You bought the ones nobody could take.

Description: Form an Elemental Five of a Kind.
Draw: Five blank playing cards fanned in a hand, all marked with the same single teardrop shape.
Said: Five cards, one color, one blow.
The shop has heard. It will have something for a hand like that.

Description: Form a Form Five of a Kind.
Draw: Five identical scimitars fanned like the fingers of an open hand, all their blades pointing the same way.
Said: Five blades that all agree on how to cut.
The shop has heard. It keeps a ring for hands like that.

Description: Form a Card Five of a Kind.
Draw: Five identical blank playing cards stacked with a slight offset, each an exact copy of the one behind it.
Said: The same card, five times over. The deck was never meant to hold that many.
Something rare has been waiting on the shelf for exactly this.

Description: Form an Elemental Four of a Kind.
Draw: Four blank playing cards fanned in a hand, a large drop dripping off the bottom edge of the lowest card.
Said: Four cards in one color, and the blow comes out the same shade.
The shop has heard. It keeps a ring that hits twice for a hand like that.

Description: Form a Card Four of a Kind.
Draw: Four identical blank playing cards laid out in a neat two-by-two square.
Said: The same card four times in one hand. The shuffle did not do that on its own.
Something rare has been waiting on the shelf for exactly this.
